SHOT: Straight-on e-commerce packshot, 4:5. ONE pair of earrings only, both earrings standing upright side by side on the top face, the hearts hanging at the front, on a cream plaster cube. Camera close, a little above the cube's top face, looking down at about thirty degrees. Macro-sharp on the metal.

THE PRODUCT: IMAGE 1 is the supplier photograph and the ONLY authority on what this piece is: copy its construction, its metal colour and its stone colour EXACTLY; they hang on a black velvet T-shaped earring stand on dark red velvet: ignore the stand and the velvet. IMAGE 2 is here ONLY for the plinth, the camera distance, the background and the light: copy its cube and its framing exactly and ignore everything else about it.

CONSTRUCTION LOCK: A PAIR OF HEART DROP HUGGIES: each is a slim polished gold huggie hoop about 11mm across whose front face is set with ONE row of small clear stones; from the bottom of the hoop a tiny gold jump ring holds ONE clear HEART-shaped faceted stone, point down, held only by FINE GOLD CLAWS at its edge (an open claw setting, the stone's sides and back open to the light), with a small bail at the top between its two lobes. The heart sits in fine claws, NEVER in a solid gold cup, bezel, frame or rim; one clear heart per earring, point down; the hoop is slim with one row of small stones; no halo.

SCALE TEST: Each hoop is about 11mm; the heart is about 6mm across; each earring is about 19mm long. The piece keeps its true small size against the cube, never enlarged.

GROUND: The cream plaster cube fills the lower half of the frame, large and close; flat faces, softly rounded corners, fine plaster grain. Warm cream seamless behind with a gentle gradient falloff, never sand, tan, beige or golden. Soft large key from camera-left, one soft shadow, plus ONE small hard specular kicker from the right, so the metal shows a bright moving highlight and a dark rolled edge on every curve, and every stone shows internal sparkle and a hard white point, never flat colour.

ABSENCE LIST: No hand, no fingers, no model, no fabric, no props, no flowers, no box. No second piece of jewellery. Metal: warm 18k gold tone, never brassy, orange or greenish. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. No border, no frame, no paper edge, no vignette: the image fills the whole frame edge to edge. A clean modern digital photograph: no creases, no fold lines, no aged-paper texture, no scratches, no film grain.
